target.title: fix(cron): remove redundant loops and dead code in stagger calculations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where `computeStaggeredCronNextRunAtMs` and `computeStaggeredCronPreviousRunAtMs` contained complex, redundant loops designed to repeatedly recalculate base schedules. Because the initial cursor shift (`nowMs - offsetMs`) already aligns the calculation window, the loop conditions are mathematically guaranteed to evaluate to `true` on the very first iteration. This made the 4-iteration loops, cursor increments/decrements, and fallback logic completely dead and redundant code.

## Why This Change Was Made

Refactored both stagger helper functions in `src/cron/service/jobs.ts` to remove the redundant loop constructs and direct return paths, simplifying the calculations to a single direct step (`baseNext + offsetMs` or `basePrevious + offsetMs`) using the correctly offset cursor.

## User Impact

Improves cron scheduling execution efficiency and code maintainability by eliminating redundant math/loops from the scheduler hot path.

## Evidence

Passed all cron stagger tests on branch `fix/2.4-cron-stagger-dead-loop-removal`:
```
 ✓ |cron| src/cron/stagger.test.ts (5 tests) 36ms
```

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified by asserting that cron stagger calculations yield identical and correct results before and after refactoring:
```
// Schedule: every hour, Offset: 15 minutes, nowMs: Top of the hour (e.g. 12:00)
// Next run calculated: 12:15 (Correct, offset added)
// Previous run calculated: 11:15 (Correct, offset added)
```
